lines.t: Before the clock began to tick, I held the timeline in my hand
Before the oceans knew their shores, I laid the foundation of the land
I am the Alpha, the Omega, first and last, the great I am
The creator of the galaxy, the shepherd and the sacrificial lamb
You ask for proof, you look for signs, you say you're searching for light
While billions of my burning stars are breaking through your darkest night
I carved my signature in stone
In every atom, every breath
I wrote the story of your life
And paved the path to conquer death
You act like I am distant
Like I'm hidden out of reach
When my glory fills the atmosphere
And speaks in every wave upon the beach
You're without excuse
It's written in the sky and on the ground
There is no corner of the earth
Where my presence can't be found
How do you not know me?
When my love was on open display
I didn't whisper from a mountain
I came down and took the pain
Look at the cross, look at the nails
Look at the blood upon the wood
I traded my own royalty
To give you everything I could
I spoke it clearly in my book
I left the truth upon the page From Genesis to Revelation
Timeless through every single age You stand without excuse
My love is clear to see I didn't leave you in the dark
To guess or wander in the fog I gave my holy word to you
The living breath of God Page by page, line by line
I laid my heart out in the ink To reach the deep, broken places
Is where you didn't think I'd think
And when the prophecies were full
I stepped down into human flesh
To bear the weight of every sin
The guilt, the shame, the heavy mess
Love wasn't quiet, wasn't hidden
Wasn't tucked away in pride
It was stretched across a wooden beam
Arms open wide until I died
I tore the veil, I broke the grave
I rose to give you brand new life
I bought the church, I cleared the dead
And called you my intended bride
I spoke through creation
I spoke through the pages
And then I spoke through my blood
What more could I have done to prove my love?
How do you not know me?
When my love was on open display
I didn't whisper from a mountain
I came down and took the pain
Look at the cross, look at the nails
Look at the blood upon the wood
I traded my own royalty to give you everything I could
I spoke it clearly in my book
I left the truth upon the page
From Genesis to Revelation
Timeless through every single age
You stand without excuse
My love is clear to see
The scribe declares it
The book reveals it
The cross sealed it
You are without excuse
Come home to me
